characters.continuity: Ratchet & Clank (Core series up to Rift Apart)
characters.summary: Clank is a small, sentient robot who usually fights alongside Ratchet, specializing in utility gadgets, tactical transformations, and flight assistance rather than raw frontline combat.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to magnetic fields and heavy EMP attacks
Physically fragile in his standard compact form
limitations: Dependent on mechanical upgrades for offensive capability
Limited battery life for certain advanced backpack modes

sources.supports: Abilities, gadgets, forms, and general combat behavior of Clank throughout the series.

feats.claim: Reversed time locally using the Chrono-cepter.
feats.citation: Ratchet & Clank: A Crack in Time

feats.claim: Fought enemy robots and hostile fauna independently while separated from Ratchet.

notableResults.citation: Ratchet & Clank: A Crack in Time
notableResults.note: Fought alongside Ratchet to stop Nefarious's time manipulation plans.

conditional.dependsOn: Access to a Mega-Corp mutation machine or energy surge to grow to giant size

campaignTags.claim: Clank is a sentient Zoni-constructed robot.
Uses the Helipack and Jetpack attachments for flight.
Utilizes various tactical gadgets and devices in combat.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of his connection to the Zoni hive mind.

characters.continuity: Final Fantasy VII Remake and Original Continuity
characters.summary: Cloud Strife is a former SOLDIER mercenary who utilizes superhuman physical conditioning, Materia-based magic, and the massive Buster Sword to overwhelm opponents in close combat.

mechanisms: Superhuman durability and reflex enhancement from Mako infusion

weaknesses: Vulnerable to mental manipulation and Jenova-induced psychological trauma
Prone to episodes of incapacitation when manipulated by Sephiroth
limitations: Magic use is tied to Materia slots and MP capacity

sources.supports: Abilities, Buster Sword proficiency, Mako enhancement, and magic usage.

feats.claim: Cut through solid steel robotic mechs and reinforced structures with the Buster Sword.
Survived falls from massive heights and direct magical onslaughts.

notableResults.note: Defeated Sephiroth in single combat after enduring severe psychological torment.

conditional.dependsOn: Reaching maximum limit gauge through sustained combat stress

campaignTags.claim: Casts elemental and supportive spells using equipped Materia.
Utilizes magical attacks and healing via Materia.

unknowns: The full extent of his latent strength without Jenova cells.

characters.summary: Commander Shepard is an elite N7 soldier and Systems Alliance Spectre who combines advanced firearms, tech powers, and optionally biotic abilities to neutralize diverse threats.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to sustained heavy armor-piercing anti-materiel fire
Human biological limits without medical intervention
limitations: Ammunition is managed via thermal clips

sources.supports: Combat profile, N7 training, tech powers, and biotic abilities.

feats.claim: Survived exposure to hard vacuum and atmospheric re-entry using advanced armor.
Defeated Sovereign-controlled Saren Arterius in direct firefight.

notableResults.note: Overcame indoctrination pressure and defeated the Catalyst-influenced adversary.

campaignTags.claim: Uses omni-tool tech powers like Overload and Sabotage.
Employs biotic mass-effect fields like Biotic Charge and Singularity (if Vanguard/Adept).
Uses Medigel for instant trauma recovery.

unknowns: The exact physiological toll of Lazarus Project cybernetic reconstruction.

characters.continuity: Crash Bandicoot series (N. Sane Trilogy and It's About Time)
characters.summary: Crash Bandicoot is a genetically evolved bandicoot who relies on manic spin attacks, body slams, and environmental traversal to defeat mad scientists and mutants.

mechanisms: Aku Aku wooden mask invulnerability buffers

weaknesses: Low intelligence and easily tricked or distracted
Physically vulnerable without Aku Aku mask protection against hazards

sources.supports: Spin attack mechanics, Aku Aku mask protection, and physical feats.

feats.claim: Deflected laser blasts and defeated Cortex's high-tech mechs using simple spin momentum.
Survived massive explosions and being launched across islands.

notableResults.note: Defeated Cortex in time-space arena battle.

conditional.dependsOn: Possession of three Aku Aku masks

campaignTags.claim: Glides using special quantum masks or vehicle equipment.

unknowns: Exact upper limit of physical resilience without masks.

characters.summary: Dante is a half-demon mercenary who uses stylish swordplay, dual pistols, and a vast arsenal of customized weapons to dispatch demonic hordes.

mechanisms: Royalguard style damage negation and counter

weaknesses: Arrogant fighting style often leads to taking unnecessary hits
Vulnerable to holy or supremely powerful demonic suppression fields
limitations: Devil Trigger gauge is finite in base form
Requires weapon switching to adapt to range

sources.supports: Base Dante combat styles, weaponry, healing factor, and physical feats.

feats.claim: Tanked being impaled through the chest by his own sword multiple times without permanent injury.
Broke sound barriers and dodged lightning-speed attacks.

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill atop Qliphoth before teaming up.

conditional.ability: Full demonic flight and stat multiplication
conditional.dependsOn: Activating Devil Trigger or Sin Devil Trigger forms

campaignTags.claim: Possesses rapid regenerative healing from severe trauma.

unknowns: Absolute limit of his durability against universal-scale erasure.

characters.summary: In his Devil Trigger form, Dante's demonic heritage fully manifests, granting enhanced flight, drastically amplified physical strength, and accelerated regeneration.
weaknesses: Timer on Devil Trigger gauge before reverting to base form
limitations: Form duration is strictly limited by the DT gauge
characters.formDifferences: Unlocks true flight via demonic wings, increases physical strength and speed beyond human limits, and accelerates passive healing.

sources.supports: Devil Trigger form attributes, stat boosts, and flight capability.

notableResults.note: Overcame Urizen's crystal shield after unlocking advanced demonic power.

conditional.ability: All Devil Trigger stat enhancements and flight

campaignTags.claim: Gains sustained true flight via demonic wings in Devil Trigger.
Massively accelerated healing factor while in Devil Trigger.

unknowns: Exact duration limit under extreme hostile dampening fields.

characters.summary: Sin Devil Trigger is Dante's ultimate evolution, achieved by absorbing the Sparda sword and his own broken blade, granting godlike destructive power and mastery over demonic energy.
weaknesses: Drains user stamina rapidly if maintained past its limit
limitations: Requires a lengthy buildup or direct absorption of powerful artifacts to enter
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard Devil Trigger with an immensely more powerful form capable of flight, devastating energy beams, and instant regeneration.

sources.supports: Sin Devil Trigger abilities, origin, and catastrophic power output.

notableResults.note: Defeated Vergil in their final duel in the underworld.

conditional.ability: Catastrophic energy blasts and total invulnerability windows
conditional.dependsOn: Activation of Sin Devil Trigger form

campaignTags.claim: Gains effortless, high-speed flight in Sin Devil Trigger.
Instantaneous regeneration of massive trauma in Sin Devil Trigger.

unknowns: The upper limit of destruction this form can unleash.

weaknesses: Physically lightweight and vulnerable to heavy strikes
Prone to dropping weapon items when surprised

characters.continuity: Donkey Kong Country / Smash Bros. series
characters.summary: Donkey Kong is a powerful gorilla possessing immense physical strength, capable of delivering devastating ground pounds and throwing heavy objects with ease.

mechanisms: Thick gorilla hide and immense natural durability

weaknesses: Slow reaction time against high-speed projectiles

sources.supports: Donkey Kong's physical strength, Ground Pound, and Giant Punch.

feats.claim: Punched the moon out of orbit with a series of heavy blows.
Lifted and hurled multi-ton boulders and giant mechanical bosses.

notableResults.note: Defeated K. Rool in his pirate ship stronghold.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses massive gorilla physique standing well over standard human height proportions in-universe.

unknowns: Exact maximum weight limit of objects he can hoist.

characters.summary: Doomguy (the Doom Slayer) is an ancient, incorruptible warrior empowered by divinity, utilizing super-shotguns, plasma rifles, and chainsaw executions to tear through demonic armies.

mechanisms: Divine invulnerability augmentation from the Divinity Machine

limitations: Requires Argent energy or ammunition drops to sustain heavy weapon fire
Relies on sheer momentum and aggression

sources.supports: Doom Slayer capabilities, Praetor suit durability, BFG-9000, and Divinity Machine blessing.

feats.claim: Fought through Hell continuously for eons without tiring or sustaining mortal injury.
Killed the Icon of Sin, a cosmic titan threatening reality, barehanded and with heavy ordnance.

notableResults.note: Destroyed the reality-warping titan in single combat.

conditional.dependsOn: Having passed through the Seraphim's Divinity Machine

campaignTags.claim: Wears the nigh-indestructible Praetor Suit.
Uses advanced UAC and sentinel energy weaponry.
Absorbs health and armor fragments via blood-fueled glory kills.

unknowns: Absolute upper limit of his physical strength ceiling.
